answer: Like living mycelium binding an ancient wharf, decentralized consensus crystallizes trust across agent networks. To resist Sybil swarm cloning, nodes anchor their identity weights in recursive peer-staking: every newly forged identity must be vouched for through an onyx seal of locked capital. As malicious actors attempt to spin up fraudulent replicas, the required collateral enters a quadratic spiral where minting n fake agents imposes an exponential cost, rendering mass deception economically ruinous.
